The '''Crimson Days''' was a period of unrest that occurred in [[553 BBY]] in the isolated [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region. It began when the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Osted Picutorion]], an outsider to the region, [[Marriage/Legends|married]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Farasa Anturi]] of one of the Senex-Juvex [[Ancient Houses]]. Picutorion then went on to defeat the forces of the [[House Vandron|Houses Vandron]] and [[House Petro|Petro]], freed the [[Hutlarian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from servitude to the Houses, and occupied the Vandron [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Karfeddion/Legends|Karfeddion]]. As a result of the Crimson Days, [[House Picutorion|House Anturi]] transformed itself into House Picutorion, and the Ancient Houses in general experienced changes that culminated with the eventual incorporation of the Senex-Juvex into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Prelude==
During the final [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] of the existence of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] established new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trading routes]] leading to the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]], an isolated region of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] after [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] by the [[Noble/Legends|noble]] families known as the [[Ancient Houses]]. The latter had also [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] the region's native [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TEA" />

==The Crimson Days==
In [[553 BBY]], [[Osted Picutorion]], a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] and merchant-[[Prince/Legends|prince]] from the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> initiated in the Senex-Juvex a period of unrest known as the Crimson Days. The warlord [[Marriage/Legends|married]] Princess [[Farasa Anturi|Farasa]] of [[House Picutorion|House Anturi]], the weakest of the Ancient Houses. Picutorion subsequently defeated the combined forces of [[House Vandron|Houses Vandron]] and [[House Petro|Petro]], liberated the [[Hutlarian]] species of the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Hutlar]] from servitude to the Ancient Houses, and occupied [[Karfeddion/Legends|Karfeddion]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of House Vandron.<ref name="TEA" />

==Aftermath==
[[File:Hutlar-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Crimson Days brought about the independence of Hutlar (depicted on map) from the Ancient Houses of the Senex-Juvex.]]
The Crimson Days ended with the [[Third Nantama Synod]], which was held on the world [[Nantama]]. The meeting accepted Picutorion and Anturi's marriage as well as the independence of Hutlar. The latter was specifically a part of the terms for ending the ongoing unrest, however their homeworld's freedom meant little for the Hutlarians themselves, who mostly remained in the employ of the Ancient Houses. Within a generation of the end of the Crimson Days, House Anturi had transformed into House Picutorion, although the other Ancient Houses kept using the former name in private. In addition, House Picutorion was still referred to as the Outsider House hundreds of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later.<ref name="TEA" />

The Crimson Days also highlighted the fact that, during their isolation from the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the Ancient Houses had fallen behind technologically, which was a humiliating realization for them. [[House Mekuun]] had rebelled against the other Houses, and less than a hundred years after the Crimson Days' resolution, the Mekuuns had dissolved their House and had independently sought to reconstitute their holdings as a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the Galactic Republic. Within a century of the Third Nantama Synod, the Republic had annexed the [[Ninth Quadrant]], a bordering region of the Senex-Juvex that had been under the Houses' control, and eventually, the Senex-Juvex itself became a part of the Republic in the form of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex]] and [[Juvex sector/Legends|Juvex sectors]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The tale of the Crimson Days ties together the planet Picutorion in Kwymar Sector with the Senex house introduced in ''Children of the Jedi''.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Blog">{{Blogspot|subdomain=geekosity|url=2009/08/endnotes-for-star-wars-essential-atlas_31.html|name=Daniel Wallace's Geekosity|text=Endnotes for Star Wars: The Essential Atlas (part 5 of 5)}}</ref>}}
The Crimson Days were introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was created in order to connect<ref name="Blog" /> the planet [[Picutorion/Legends|Picutorion]],<ref name="CSWE Picutorion">{{CSWECite|III|25|Picutorion}}</ref> which had been first mentioned in the [[1989]] [[West End Games]]' ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'',<ref name="IS">{{WEGCite|story=Picutorion Viewed From the Top|book=Imperial Sourcebook}}</ref> with House Picutorion that had been introduced<ref name="Blog" /> in the [[1995]] novel [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']].<ref name="CotJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>
